items.title: LEGO
items.description: People of all ages love building with LEGO! In this title, readers can explore the history of the famous toy company, from its early years to its present-day products, charitable giving, and fan engagement. Special features profile a person important to the brand’s beginnings, locate the company headquarters, show off favorite LEGO sets, highlight charitable giving, call out a fan event, and more. Students will enjoy building their reading skills with this fun, fact-filled book!
